children: Shoulder Innovations said it agreed to an exclusive collaboration with ALM Ortho to work on a  bespoke implant to treat severe shoulder deformity.

The medical technology company, which focuses on the shoulder surgical care market, said the planned implant will use ALM Ortho's titanium orthopedic implants and address cases for which there is currently no adequate solution.
It said it owns exclusive rights for upper extremity applications of ALM's U.S. solutions.

"We look forward to working with ALM Ortho with this new capability in the marketplace, which we expect will drive improved patient outcomes and yield strategic advantages for SI as our commercial engine continues to grow," Chief Executive Rob Ball said.
Financial terms of the deal weren't disclosed.
